designationHistory.indexText: The National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2023 established the Numunaa Nobe National Conservation Area in Nevada.

authority.citation: Public Law 117-263, div. B, title XXIX, sec. 2903(a), 136 Stat. 2395, 3034

designationHistory.note: Designated December 23, 2022, not in 2024-2025 as the brief assumed. Enacted with the Fallon Range Training Complex land provisions; about 160,000 acres per the law.
